mapper.select: SELECT FROM email_notifications WHERE invitation_id=#{invitationId} AND invitation_version=#{invitationVersion} AND active_marker=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(send_no),0)+1 FROM email_notifications WHERE invitation_id=#{invitationId} AND invitation_version=#{invitationVersion}
SELECT FROM email_notifications WHERE ORDER BY confirmed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM email_notifications WHERE task_status IN ('READY','SUBMITTING','SUBMIT_RETRY','SUBMIT_UNKNOWN','POLLING') AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_run_at,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT version FROM invitations WHERE id=#{id}
